sources.title: GitHub - MinishLab/model2vec: Fast State-of-the-Art Static Embeddings
sources.snippet: 23/05/2025: We released potion-multilingual-128M, a multilingual model trained on 101 languages. It is the best performing static embedding model for multilingual tasks, and is capable of generating embeddings for any text in any language.

sources.title: potion-multilingual-128M: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview potion-multilingual-128M is a static multilingual text embedding model developed by minishlab that generates 256-dimensional embeddings for text in 101 languages. Built using the Model2Vec framework and trained with Tokenlearn on 2 million sentences from the C4 dataset across 101 languages, this model is a distilled version of BAAI/bge-m3 designed specifically for resource-constrained ...
